entries.name: Asteroid Game
entries.description_en: A browser space-shooter demo from OpenAI's single-prompt GPT-5 coding collection, with the generating prompt and published app files.
entries.description_zh: OpenAI 单次提示生成作品集中的浏览器太空射击游戏，公开生成提示和应用文件。
entries.limits_en: An illustrative coding demo, with no published agent task evaluator. The public demo URL responded; gameplay was not tested.
entries.limits_zh: 属于编程演示，未提供 Agent 任务评分器。已检查公开演示链接，未进行游戏操作测试。
entries.enables_en: Inspect and remix an AI-generated arcade game, using its original prompt as a starting point.
entries.enables_zh: 查看和改造 AI 生成的街机游戏，并参考原始提示进行再创作。

evidence.supports: OpenAI states that the collection was generated from single GPT-5 or GPT-5.2 prompts without handwritten code.
Identifies this example and its space-shooter prompt.
Public app endpoint returned HTTP 200; no interaction test was performed.

entries.name: Tiny Kanban
entries.description_en: A generated browser app for moving task cards between Todo, Doing and Done, with local persistence, search and work-in-progress limits.
entries.description_zh: AI 生成的浏览器看板应用，支持卡片流转、本地保存、搜索和进行中任务数量限制。
entries.limits_en: The published implementation stores data in browser localStorage. It is a demo, not a documented multi-user service or benchmark.
entries.limits_zh: 公开实现使用浏览器 localStorage 保存数据；属于演示项目，未声明多人协作服务或评测能力。
entries.enables_en: Inspect how an AI-generated single-file app implements a useful task-management workflow.
entries.enables_zh: 观察 AI 生成的单文件应用如何实现实际的任务管理流程。

evidence.supports: The publisher explicitly attributes the collection to single-prompt AI code generation.
Source contains card dragging, search, WIP checks and localStorage.
Public app endpoint returned HTTP 200; no interaction test was performed.

entries.name: Claude's C Compiler
entries.description_en: An experimental C compiler written in Rust by Claude Opus 4.6, released by Anthropic as an artifact of its agent-team research.
entries.description_zh: Anthropic 发布的 Agent 团队研究产物：由 Claude Opus 4.6 编写、以 Rust 实现的实验性 C 编译器。
entries.limits_en: The human-authored repository notice warns that correctness is unvalidated and discourages use. Linux is the documented host; this is a research artifact.
entries.limits_zh: 仓库中的人工说明明确表示正确性未经验证，并不建议实际使用。文档要求 Linux 主机，应视作研究产物。
entries.enables_en: Study the source and development history of a substantial AI-authored systems program.
entries.enables_zh: 研究较大规模 AI 编写系统软件的源码和开发历史。

evidence.supports: The human-authored notice attributes code and documentation to Claude, with human-written tests and Linux-only development.
The author describes the agent-team process and its limitations.

entries.name: FastRender
entries.description_en: An experimental Rust browser engine and desktop shell produced during Cursor's research on long-running, collaborating coding agents.
entries.description_zh: Cursor 长时间多 Agent 编程研究产生的实验性 Rust 浏览器引擎及桌面外壳。
entries.limits_en: The authors describe unstable APIs and incomplete web APIs, and advise against production use. Platform tags follow the documented macOS/Linux build instructions.
entries.limits_zh: 作者说明 API 不稳定、部分 Web API 尚不完整，不建议用于生产。平台标签依据 macOS/Linux 构建文档。
entries.enables_en: Inspect an AI-authored browser implementation and its rendering pipeline as a research example.
entries.enables_zh: 以研究案例形式查看 AI 编写的浏览器实现及其渲染流程。

evidence.supports: Cursor identifies the linked repository as a browser built by its long-running coding agents.
The repository links the agent research, documents macOS/Linux builds, and states incomplete support and production limitations.

entries.name: Crafter
entries.description_en: A procedurally generated survival game for studying exploration, resource collection and crafting, with achievement-based agent evaluation.
entries.description_zh: 程序化生成的生存游戏，通过资源收集、制作和生存成就研究探索与长期决策能力。
entries.limits_en: A simplified 2D research world. Python and a Pygame human interface are documented; the reviewed sources do not enumerate tested operating systems.
entries.limits_zh: 属于简化的二维研究环境。文档提供 Python 和 Pygame 人类界面，但未列出已测试的操作系统。
entries.enables_en: Train agents and measure which survival and crafting achievements they can unlock.
entries.enables_zh: 训练 Agent，并观察其能解锁哪些生存和制作成就。
entries.runtime: Python; optional Pygame GUI
entries.platform_note: No OS tag was inferred from the Python implementation.

evidence.supports: Documents the playable environment, Python API, achievements and GUI installation.
Original paper defines the training and achievement-based evaluation setting.

entries.name: TextWorld
entries.description_en: A toolkit for generating and playing text adventures with controlled task difficulty, state tracking and rewards for learning agents.
entries.description_zh: 可生成和运行文字冒险的工具包，支持控制任务难度、跟踪状态并为学习型 Agent 提供奖励。
entries.limits_en: Text interaction rather than a visual desktop. Native support is documented for Linux/macOS; Windows requires a Docker workaround.
entries.limits_zh: 交互以文字为主。文档声明原生支持 Linux/macOS；Windows 需采用 Docker 方案。
entries.enables_en: Create controlled text-game curricula and test generalization across related adventures.
entries.enables_zh: 构建难度可控的文字游戏课程，评估 Agent 在相关游戏间的泛化能力。

evidence.supports: Documents game generation, RL use, Python support and operating-system constraints.
Original paper explains controllable generated games and learning/evaluation use.

entries.name: MiniHack
entries.description_en: A NetHack-based sandbox for building compact game tasks, from navigation and object use to procedurally generated challenges.
entries.description_zh: 基于 NetHack 的任务沙盒，可构建导航、物品使用以及程序化生成的游戏挑战。
entries.limits_en: Requires NetHack Learning Environment dependencies. Windows uses Docker. The public level editor is an authoring tool, not a hosted benchmark run.
entries.limits_zh: 依赖 NetHack Learning Environment；Windows 使用 Docker。公开关卡编辑器是任务制作工具，并非在线评测服务。
entries.enables_en: Design controlled game tasks to test exploration, planning and skill composition.
entries.enables_zh: 设计可控游戏任务，研究探索、规划和技能组合。

evidence.supports: Current author-maintained repository documents NetHack-based tasks and the Gymnasium API.
Documents macOS/Ubuntu dependency guidance and the Windows Docker path.
Original paper defines MiniHack as a configurable RL sandbox.

entries.name: WebArena
entries.description_en: Self-hostable websites and task evaluators for agents working across shopping, forums, content management and software collaboration.
entries.description_zh: 可自行部署的网站及任务评分器，覆盖购物、论坛、内容管理和软件协作等网页操作。
entries.limits_en: Reproducible evaluation requires self-hosted services and controlled state resets. Shared demonstration sites are not a substitute for that setup.
entries.limits_zh: 可复现评测需要自行部署服务并控制状态重置，不能直接以共享演示站点替代。
entries.enables_en: Measure completion of multi-step web tasks using executable checks of the resulting state.
entries.enables_zh: 通过可执行的结果检查，评估 Agent 是否完成多步骤网页任务。

evidence.supports: Canonical implementation documents self-hosting, task execution and the distinction between demos and reproducible experiments.
Original paper describes functional websites and task-success evaluation.

entries.name: VisualWebArena
entries.description_en: A web-agent benchmark whose shopping, classifieds and forum tasks require visual information alongside text.
entries.description_zh: 结合图像和文字信息的网页 Agent 基准，涵盖购物、分类信息和论坛任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires hosting the provided sites and matching the task configuration. The repository documents Python-version constraints; no hosted evaluation service is claimed.
entries.limits_zh: 需要部署配套站点并匹配任务配置；仓库还列有 Python 版本限制。此处不提供托管评测服务。
entries.enables_en: Test whether an agent can use images and page content to finish realistic web tasks.
entries.enables_zh: 评估 Agent 能否结合图像与页面内容完成实际网页任务。

evidence.supports: Documents the website setup, visual tasks, task configurations and execution-based evaluation.
Original paper explains why the tasks require multimodal web interaction.

entries.name: WorkArena
entries.description_en: A ServiceNow-based task suite for evaluating agents on workplace workflows such as searching knowledge bases, filling forms and filtering records.
entries.description_zh: 基于 ServiceNow 的办公任务套件，用于评估知识库搜索、表单填写和记录筛选等能力。
entries.limits_en: ServiceNow instances currently require approved access through the authors' gated dataset. WorkArena++ extends the original suite; task versions must be reported.
entries.limits_zh: 当前需通过作者的受限数据集申请 ServiceNow 实例访问。WorkArena++ 扩展了原始套件，报告结果时应注明版本。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate structured enterprise workflows with task-specific validation.
entries.enables_zh: 使用任务专用验证器评估企业软件中的结构化操作流程。

evidence.supports: Documents task families, gated instance access and the WorkArena/WorkArena++ relationship.
Original paper introduces the ServiceNow knowledge-work benchmark.

entries.name: BrowserGym
entries.description_en: A shared browser environment interface that connects agents to multiple web benchmarks and exposes consistent observations and actions.
entries.description_zh: 连接多种网页基准的统一浏览器环境接口，为 Agent 提供一致的观察和动作表示。
entries.limits_en: A research framework rather than a new website task collection. Each integrated benchmark keeps its own setup, access and evaluation requirements.
entries.limits_zh: 这是研究框架，并非另一套独立网页任务；接入的各个基准仍有各自的部署、访问和评测要求。
entries.enables_en: Reuse agent integrations and compare behavior across supported web environments.
entries.enables_zh: 复用 Agent 接口，并比较它在不同网页环境中的行为。

evidence.supports: Documents the common interface, benchmark integrations and per-benchmark setup.
The ecosystem paper explains standardized browser observations, actions and evaluation.

entries.name: OSWorld
entries.description_en: A desktop-agent environment with application workflows, file operations and executable task checks; the original paper introduced 369 tasks.
entries.description_zh: 包含应用操作、文件处理和可执行任务检查的桌面 Agent 环境，原始论文发布了 369 项任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires VM images and supported providers. The repository includes OSWorld-Verified updates; comparisons must identify the version. Running on a macOS host does not imply macOS task coverage.
entries.limits_zh: 需要虚拟机镜像及受支持的运行方式。仓库包含 OSWorld-Verified 更新，比较结果时应注明版本；Mac 主机支持不等于 macOS 任务覆盖。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate multi-application computer use against final application and file states.
entries.enables_zh: 通过应用和文件的最终状态，评估跨应用电脑操作能力。
entries.platform_note: Tags follow the Ubuntu/Windows guest choices in the reviewed repository, rather than the broader OS list in the original abstract.

evidence.supports: Documents VM setup, Ubuntu/Windows guest choices and OSWorld-Verified version changes.
Original paper describes application tasks and execution-based checks.

entries.name: AndroidWorld
entries.description_en: An Android emulator environment with parameterized tasks and state-based rewards across everyday mobile applications.
entries.description_zh: 运行于 Android 模拟器的环境，为日常移动应用提供参数化任务和基于系统状态的奖励。
entries.limits_en: Requires a configured Android emulator and the prescribed apps. Host compatibility differs from the Android target; Apple Silicon Docker setup has documented caveats.
entries.limits_zh: 需要配置 Android 模拟器及指定应用。主机兼容性与 Android 目标平台应分开理解，Apple Silicon 的 Docker 方案有已知限制。
entries.enables_en: Train or evaluate agents on repeatable mobile workflows with varied task parameters.
entries.enables_zh: 通过不同任务参数，训练或评估可重复的移动端操作流程。

evidence.supports: Documents the live emulator, dynamic tasks, reward signals and setup constraints.
Original paper describes parameterized workflows and system-state evaluation.

entries.name: Windows Agent Arena
entries.description_en: A Windows desktop-agent benchmark and environment for application, browser and operating-system tasks, with local and Azure execution paths.
entries.description_zh: 面向 Windows 应用、浏览器和操作系统任务的桌面 Agent 基准与环境，提供本地及 Azure 运行方式。
entries.limits_en: Setup requires a Windows VM image, Docker and dependencies. The documented evaluation ISO is a time-limited trial; Azure execution can incur costs.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Windows 虚拟机镜像、Docker 和配套依赖。文档使用有期限的评估版 ISO；Azure 运行可能产生费用。
entries.enables_en: Assess Windows GUI task completion with repeatable initial states and evaluators.
entries.enables_zh: 使用可重复的初始状态和评分器，评估 Windows 图形界面任务完成情况。

evidence.supports: Documents the Windows environment, Docker/VM setup and local/cloud execution.
Original paper defines the Windows task suite and scalable evaluation approach.

entries.name: iOSWorld
entries.description_en: An iPhone Simulator benchmark with 26 purpose-built apps, a shared fictional user profile and tasks that span apps and personal context.
entries.description_zh: 基于 iPhone 模拟器的基准，包含 26 个专门构建的应用、统一虚构用户数据，以及跨应用和个人背景相关任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires macOS, Xcode and an iOS simulator. These are seeded research apps, not App Store products; the default scoring path uses a model judge.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 macOS、Xcode 和 iOS 模拟器。应用使用预置研究数据，并非 App Store 产品；默认评分流程采用模型评审。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate cross-app phone tasks and reasoning over a consistent synthetic personal history.
entries.enables_zh: 评估跨应用手机任务，以及对一致的合成个人历史进行推理的能力。

evidence.supports: The authors state that apps were developed or adapted with Claude Code assistance and manually verified by human developers.
Documents runnable SwiftUI apps, benchmark runners, simulator requirements and default judge behavior.

entries.name: MacArena
entries.description_en: A macOS computer-use benchmark combining ported desktop tasks with macOS-specific workflows in an Apple Silicon virtual-machine environment.
entries.description_zh: 面向 macOS 的电脑操作基准，在 Apple Silicon 虚拟机环境中组合移植桌面任务与 macOS 特有流程。
entries.limits_en: Requires Apple hardware and macOS VM setup. Tasks inherited from macOSWorld carry CC BY-NC 4.0 restrictions; application and OS licenses also apply.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Apple 硬件和 macOS 虚拟机配置。继承自 macOSWorld 的任务采用 CC BY-NC 4.0，另需遵守系统和应用许可。
entries.enables_en: Test whether desktop-agent skills transfer to native macOS interfaces and workflows.
entries.enables_zh: 检验桌面 Agent 能力能否迁移到原生 macOS 界面及操作流程。

evidence.supports: Documents UTM/VM setup, task sources and source-specific license restrictions.
Original paper describes the Apple Silicon environment and macOS-specific evaluation.

entries.name: Brutalist Dev Platform
entries.description_en: An AI-generated developer-platform landing page with a monochrome grid, animated terminal, code tabs, pricing table and signup dialog.
entries.description_zh: AI 生成的开发者平台落地页，包含黑白网格、终端动画、代码标签页、价格表和注册弹窗。
entries.limits_en: A fictional marketing-site demo, not an operating developer service or agent benchmark. The public page responded; its interactions were not independently tested.
entries.limits_zh: 这是虚构产品的营销网站演示，并非实际开发者服务或 Agent 基准。公开页面可访问，未独立测试交互。
entries.enables_en: Inspect a prompt and its generated HTML to study a complete landing-page design.
entries.enables_zh: 对照原始提示与生成的 HTML，研究完整落地页的设计和实现。

evidence.supports: OpenAI attributes this collection to single GPT-5 or GPT-5.2 prompts without handwritten code.
The example's original prompt identifies its landing-page design and requested interactions.
Published source contains the terminal animation, code copying and signup dialog.
Public demo returned HTTP 200; no interactive or service-functionality test was performed.

entries.name: Smartwatch Product Page
entries.description_en: An AI-generated product-launch website for a fictional smartwatch, with a specification section, product options and a simulated preorder form.
entries.description_zh: AI 生成的虚构智能手表发布网站，包含规格介绍、产品选项和模拟预订表单。
entries.limits_en: The source stores simulated preorders in browser localStorage; no real sale or payment service is documented. The page responded, but the form was not exercised.
entries.limits_zh: 源码将模拟预订保存在浏览器 localStorage，未提供真实销售或支付服务。页面可访问，但未提交或操作表单。
entries.enables_en: Study how a single prompt becomes a product-marketing page with a client-side form.
entries.enables_zh: 研究单次提示如何生成包含前端表单的产品营销页面。

evidence.supports: The publisher explicitly attributes the collection to AI generation.
Original example specifies the product-launch page and preorder form.
Source labels the page a concept demo and implements preorder storage with localStorage.
Public demo returned HTTP 200; no form submission or interaction test was performed.
Collection publishes an MIT license.

entries.name: WebShop
entries.description_en: A simulated shopping website where agents search, inspect and select products to satisfy natural-language requests, with HTML and simplified text interfaces.
entries.description_zh: 模拟购物网站，Agent 根据自然语言要求搜索、查看并选择商品，提供 HTML 和简化文本两种接口。
entries.limits_en: Requires product data, Python/Java dependencies and a search index. The default preview loads a product subset; report the chosen dataset configuration when comparing results.
entries.limits_zh: 需要商品数据、Python/Java 依赖和搜索索引。默认预览仅加载部分商品，比较结果时应说明数据配置。
entries.enables_en: Train shopping agents and evaluate whether their final product selection matches the requested attributes.
entries.enables_zh: 训练购物 Agent，并评估最终商品选择是否符合用户要求的属性。

evidence.supports: Documents shopping tasks, HTML/text interfaces, setup and the default 1,000-product configuration.
Original paper introduces grounded shopping interaction and product-selection rewards.

entries.name: MiniWoB++
entries.description_en: A collection of compact browser tasks for clicking, typing, selecting and manipulating interface elements, exposed through Gymnasium and JavaScript interfaces.
entries.description_zh: 由点击、输入、选择和操作界面元素等小型浏览器任务组成，提供 Gymnasium 与 JavaScript 接口。
entries.limits_en: Synthetic tasks isolate interaction skills rather than full production workflows. The project is in maintenance mode; its Python interface documents Linux/macOS and Chrome or Chromium setup.
entries.limits_zh: 合成任务主要隔离测试交互技能，不能等同于完整生产流程。项目处于维护模式；Python 接口文档要求 Linux/macOS 及 Chrome 或 Chromium 配置。
entries.enables_en: Train and compare agents on repeatable, relatively small web-control problems.
entries.enables_zh: 在可重复、规模较小的网页操作问题上训练和比较 Agent。
entries.platform_note: Web is the task target; Linux and macOS are documented hosts for the Python runner.

evidence.supports: Documents over 100 browser environments, Gymnasium/Selenium interfaces, host support and maintenance status.
Official documentation defines the supported browser actions.

entries.name: Mind2Web
entries.description_en: An offline dataset and benchmark of human web-task demonstrations, pairing instructions and action sequences with captured webpage information.
entries.description_zh: 离线网页任务演示数据集与基准，将任务指令、人工操作序列和抓取的页面信息配对。
entries.limits_en: The original benchmark evaluates recorded actions rather than executing live websites. Dataset and code licenses differ; use the stated splits and macro-average metrics for paper comparisons.
entries.limits_zh: 原始基准评估记录中的操作，并不实际执行在线网站。数据集和代码采用不同许可；对比论文时应使用指定划分与宏平均指标。
entries.enables_en: Train action-prediction models and test generalization to unseen tasks, websites and domains.
entries.enables_zh: 训练动作预测模型，并评估对未见任务、网站和领域的泛化能力。

evidence.supports: Documents demonstrations, snapshots, training/evaluation splits, corrected averaging guidance and separate data/code licenses.
Original paper defines generalization settings using real-website demonstrations.

entries.name: Online-Mind2Web
entries.description_en: A live-web benchmark with tasks across public websites, trajectory submissions and WebJudge evaluation, maintained separately from the offline Mind2Web dataset.
entries.description_zh: 面向公开在线网站的任务基准，提供轨迹提交规范和 WebJudge 评估，与离线 Mind2Web 数据集分别维护。
entries.limits_en: Live sites and task definitions change; retain the task revision and run date. Automatic judging is model-based, and leaderboard human review has its own submission and pricing policies.
entries.limits_zh: 在线网站和任务定义会变化，应记录任务版本与运行日期。自动评分采用模型评审；排行榜人工审核另有提交和收费规则。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate end-to-end web agents on current websites and inspect the supporting action and screenshot evidence.
entries.enables_zh: 在在线网站上评估端到端网页 Agent，并检查其操作记录和截图证据。

evidence.supports: Documents 300 live-site tasks, ongoing replacements, WebJudge, v2 submission schema and human-review policy.
Original paper examines online web-agent evaluation and automatic judging.

entries.name: WebVoyager
entries.description_en: A browser-agent implementation and benchmark that combine screenshots and textual information to carry out tasks on real websites using Selenium.
entries.description_zh: 结合截图与文字信息、通过 Selenium 在真实网站上执行任务的浏览器 Agent 实现及基准。
entries.limits_en: Depends on changing external websites, Chrome/Selenium and model access. Its automated evaluation uses a vision-language judge; results are not deterministic state-check scores.
entries.limits_zh: 依赖持续变化的外部网站、Chrome/Selenium 和模型访问。自动评估使用视觉语言模型评审，结果并非确定性的状态检查分数。
entries.enables_en: Study a runnable multimodal web agent and evaluate complete browsing trajectories.
entries.enables_zh: 研究可运行的多模态网页 Agent，并评估完整浏览轨迹。

evidence.supports: Provides the Selenium browser environment, live task data, agent implementation and automated evaluation protocol.
Original paper describes end-to-end web interaction using multimodal observations.

entries.name: VisualWebBench
entries.description_en: A static multimodal web benchmark covering page understanding, OCR, element localization and action grounding from website screenshots.
entries.description_zh: 基于网站截图的静态多模态网页基准，覆盖页面理解、OCR、元素定位和动作定位。
entries.limits_en: Question-answer and grounding evaluation does not execute multi-step browsing tasks. The seven task subsets should be reported separately when diagnosing a model.
entries.limits_zh: 问答和定位评估不会执行多步骤浏览任务。分析模型时应分别报告七个任务子集的结果。
entries.enables_en: Identify whether a web agent's visual model struggles with reading, page semantics or locating controls.
entries.enables_zh: 区分网页 Agent 的视觉模型在阅读、页面语义或控件定位方面的不足。

evidence.supports: Defines seven QA-style visual web tasks and supplies evaluation adapters.
Official dataset exposes test subsets with screenshots, instructions and reference answers.

entries.name: AgentBench
entries.description_en: A multi-domain agent benchmark whose current function-calling edition provides containerized tasks for operating-system commands, databases, knowledge graphs, shopping and text-based household tasks.
entries.description_zh: 跨领域 Agent 基准，当前函数调用版本为系统命令、数据库、知识图谱、购物和文本家庭任务等任务提供容器化运行。
entries.limits_en: The current function-calling edition differs from the original eight-environment benchmark. Docker services can be resource intensive; the README documents ALFWorld memory/disk leakage and WebShop memory needs.
entries.limits_zh: 当前函数调用版本与原始八环境基准不同。Docker 服务可能消耗较多资源；README 提醒 ALFWorld 存在内存／磁盘增长问题，并列出 WebShop 内存需求。
entries.enables_en: Compare multi-turn reasoning and tool use across several controlled task domains.
entries.enables_zh: 在多种受控任务领域比较多轮推理与工具使用能力。
entries.runtime: Docker Compose; function-calling task workers
entries.platform_note: A mixed-domain tool benchmark, not a claim of native desktop application support.

evidence.supports: Documents the 2025 function-calling update, AgentRL integration, five containerized task families, legacy versions and runtime caveats.
Original paper describes the earlier eight-environment AgentBench setting.
The ALFWorld environment instantiates AlfredTWEnv for text-based household tasks.

entries.name: SWE-bench
entries.description_en: A source-code repair benchmark that asks an agent to resolve a real repository issue, then evaluates its patch with the project's tests.
entries.description_zh: 源码修复基准，要求 Agent 解决真实仓库问题，再通过项目测试评估补丁。
entries.limits_en: Measures repository-level code repair, not GUI operation or complete app generation. Docker evaluation needs substantial resources; identify the dataset variant and harness version in comparisons.
entries.limits_zh: 衡量仓库级代码修复，并非图形界面操作或完整应用生成。Docker 评测需要较多资源，比较时应注明数据集变体和评测框架版本。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate coding agents against executable issue-resolution tests and reuse the supported training splits.
entries.enables_zh: 通过可执行的问题修复测试评估编程 Agent，并使用上游支持的训练划分。
entries.runtime: Python; Docker evaluation harness
entries.platform_note: The benchmark target is repository source code; host compatibility is not used as an application-platform tag.

evidence.supports: Describes issue-to-patch evaluation, available variants, training data, Docker requirements and harness changes.
Official setup guide documents container-based evaluation and resource requirements.

entries.name: Design2Code
entries.description_en: A screenshot-to-HTML benchmark with reference webpages, generated predictions and automated visual metrics for evaluating front-end code generation.
entries.description_zh: 截图到 HTML 的生成基准，提供参考网页、模型生成结果和自动视觉指标，用于评估前端代码生成。
entries.limits_en: Evaluates visual reconstruction rather than working backend features or interactive task completion. The authors specify research-only use; Design2Code and Design2Code-Hard are distinct test sets.
entries.limits_zh: 评估视觉还原，不验证后端功能或交互任务完成情况。作者限定研究用途；Design2Code 与 Design2Code-Hard 为不同测试集。
entries.enables_en: Compare how well generated webpage code reproduces a supplied visual design.
entries.enables_zh: 比较生成的网页代码对给定视觉设计的还原程度。

evidence.supports: Documents screenshot/HTML test pairs, the Hard set, Playwright rendering, evaluation and research-use restrictions.
Original paper evaluates multimodal code generation for front-end reconstruction.

entries.name: WebCode2M
entries.description_en: A web-code dataset pairing rendered page screenshots with HTML/CSS and layout information, accompanied by a screenshot-to-code evaluation pipeline.
entries.description_zh: 将网页渲染截图、HTML/CSS 和布局信息配对的数据集，附带截图到代码的评估流程。
entries.limits_en: Static page-generation data, not an interactive agent environment. The dataset card lists CC BY 4.0, while the project page states research-only use; confirm applicable terms with the authors before reuse.
entries.limits_zh: 这是静态页面生成数据，并非可交互的 Agent 环境。数据卡标注 CC BY 4.0，项目页另写研究用途限定；复用前应向作者确认适用条款。
entries.enables_en: Train and evaluate models that translate page images into code and structural layouts.
entries.enables_zh: 训练和评估从页面图像生成代码与结构布局的模型。

evidence.supports: Official data card defines screenshot, code and layout fields and lists CC BY 4.0.
Official implementation documents test data, model inference and evaluation scripts.
Author project page links the code/data and includes the separate research-use statement.

entries.name: ScreenSpot
entries.description_en: A screenshot-based GUI grounding benchmark that asks a model to locate the control named by an instruction across mobile, desktop and web interfaces.
entries.description_zh: 基于截图的 GUI 定位基准，要求模型在移动端、桌面和网页界面中找到指令所指的控件。
entries.limits_en: Tests locating a target in a static screenshot, not executing the click or completing a workflow. Platform labels describe the screenshot sources, not installable app support.
entries.limits_zh: 只测试在静态截图中定位目标，不执行点击，也不验证流程完成。平台标签表示截图来源，并非可安装应用的支持范围。
entries.enables_en: Measure the grounding component of a GUI agent independently of planning and execution.
entries.enables_zh: 将 GUI Agent 的界面定位能力与规划、执行能力分开评估。
entries.platform_note: Screenshot-source platforms; not executable native environments.

evidence.supports: Defines ScreenSpot samples as screenshots, instructions and target boxes across five platform families.
SeeClick paper introduces the GUI grounding benchmark and its role in visual agents.

entries.name: ScreenSpot-Pro
entries.description_en: A GUI grounding benchmark using high-resolution screenshots of professional software, including development tools, creative applications, CAD and office suites.
entries.description_zh: 采用专业软件高分辨率截图的 GUI 定位基准，覆盖开发工具、创意应用、CAD 和办公套件。
entries.limits_en: A static target-localization test rather than a desktop VM or task environment. Keep screenshot resolution and language settings comparable; the listed software is not bundled for use.
entries.limits_zh: 属于静态目标定位测试，并非桌面虚拟机或任务环境。比较时应保持截图分辨率与语言设置一致；不提供所列专业软件的使用副本。
entries.enables_en: Test whether a visual agent can identify small or unfamiliar controls in dense professional interfaces.
entries.enables_zh: 评估视觉 Agent 能否在密集的专业界面中识别细小或陌生控件。
entries.platform_note: Platforms reflect the source screenshots, including Windows, macOS and Ubuntu interfaces.

evidence.supports: Official repository provides the grounding evaluation scripts and language-specific entry points.
Official dataset lists the software, versions and screenshot operating systems.
Original paper defines high-resolution professional GUI grounding.

entries.name: AndroidEnv
entries.description_en: A reinforcement-learning framework that exposes Android applications through touchscreen actions, pixel observations and configurable task rewards.
entries.description_zh: 将 Android 应用封装为强化学习环境的框架，提供触屏动作、像素观察和可配置的任务奖励。
entries.limits_en: Requires an Android emulator and task-specific reward definitions. It is a framework, not one fixed benchmark; Windows host support is documented as less maintained.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Android 模拟器及任务专用奖励定义。它是框架，而非单一固定基准；文档注明 Windows 主机支持的维护程度较低。
entries.enables_en: Build repeatable Android learning tasks with a common touch interface.
entries.enables_zh: 使用统一触屏接口构建可重复的 Android 学习任务。

evidence.supports: Documents the touch-action interface, pixel observations, custom task definitions, emulator requirement and Windows caveat.
Original technical report describes Android as an RL research platform.

entries.name: Android in the Wild
entries.description_en: A large offline collection of human Android demonstrations containing natural-language goals, UI screenshots and recorded touch, typing and navigation actions.
entries.description_zh: 大规模离线人工 Android 操作演示数据，包含自然语言目标、界面截图以及触屏、输入和导航动作记录。
entries.limits_en: Recorded demonstrations and offline action-matching metrics do not provide a live Android environment. Use the published episode splits; data spans Android versions and collection-time app states.
entries.limits_zh: 记录式演示及离线动作匹配指标不等同于可运行的 Android 环境。应遵循公开的 episode 划分；数据包含不同 Android 版本和采集时的应用状态。
entries.enables_en: Train mobile action-prediction models and test robustness across task, app and Android-version splits.
entries.enables_zh: 训练移动端动作预测模型，并通过任务、应用和 Android 版本划分评估稳健性。

evidence.supports: Defines human demonstrations, Android versions, action formats, episode splits and offline action matching.
Original paper introduces the mobile-device-control dataset.

entries.name: AndroidLab
entries.description_en: An Android-agent framework with prepared virtual devices, reproducible app tasks, evaluation tooling and the Android Instruct training dataset.
entries.description_zh: Android Agent 框架，提供预设虚拟设备、可复现应用任务、评估工具和 Android Instruct 训练数据。
entries.limits_en: Requires the prescribed Android images. Documented execution uses macOS arm64 AVDs or Linux x86_64 Docker; result generation uses a model judge and needs model access.
entries.limits_zh: 需要指定 Android 镜像。文档提供 macOS arm64 AVD 与 Linux x86_64 Docker 两种运行方式；结果生成使用模型评审，需要模型访问。
entries.enables_en: Compare Android agents on controlled mobile workflows and train with the accompanying instruction data.
entries.enables_zh: 在受控移动端流程上比较 Android Agent，并使用配套指令数据进行训练。

evidence.supports: Documents prepared virtual devices, 138 tasks across nine apps, supported hosts, instruction data and judge-based result generation.
Original paper describes training and systematic benchmarking of Android agents.

entries.name: AppWorld
entries.description_en: A simulated world of connected everyday apps with APIs, persistent task state and executable checks for function-calling and interactive coding agents.
entries.description_zh: 由相互关联的日常应用组成的模拟世界，提供 API、持久任务状态和可执行检查，用于函数调用及交互式编程 Agent。
entries.limits_en: Apps are API simulations rather than native GUIs. Follow train/dev/test restrictions; protected app and task bundles have an additional encrypted-redistribution requirement.
entries.limits_zh: 应用以 API 模拟运行，并非原生图形界面。应遵循训练／开发／测试划分；受保护的应用与任务 bundle 另有加密再分发要求。
entries.enables_en: Train and evaluate agents that coordinate several apps through code, API calls or the provided MCP integration.
entries.enables_zh: 训练和评估通过代码、API 调用或配套 MCP 接口协同操作多个应用的 Agent。
entries.runtime: Python; simulated HTTP APIs; optional MCP interface
entries.platform_note: API simulation; no native desktop or mobile target platform is asserted.

evidence.supports: Documents the app/API engine, task-state evaluation, MCP integration, split restrictions and public/protected licensing.
Original paper defines controllable app worlds and interactive coding tasks.

entries.name: WebLINX
entries.description_en: A dataset and benchmark for conversational web navigation, with multi-turn human demonstrations, page observations and action-prediction evaluation tools.
entries.description_zh: 面向对话式网页导航的数据集与基准，包含多轮人工演示、页面观察和动作预测评估工具。
entries.limits_en: Evaluation follows recorded demonstrations rather than freely executing live websites. Data uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; BrowserGym/WebLINX 1.1 changes evaluated steps and must be distinguished from 1.0.
entries.limits_zh: 评估依据记录式演示，不是自由执行在线网站。数据采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；BrowserGym/WebLINX 1.1 改变了评估步骤，应与 1.0 区分。
entries.enables_en: Study agents that follow changing user instructions over a multi-turn browsing conversation.
entries.enables_zh: 研究在多轮浏览对话中跟随用户指令变化的 Agent。

evidence.supports: Official library documents demonstration/replay abstractions, training code and action-evaluation tools.
Official dataset card specifies noncommercial/share-alike terms and explains the 1.1 BrowserGym evaluation changes.

entries.name: WorkBench
entries.description_en: A workplace-agent benchmark with sandbox databases and read/write tools for tasks such as email, scheduling and project management, evaluated by the resulting state.
entries.description_zh: 提供沙盒数据库和读写工具的办公 Agent 基准，包含邮件、日程与项目管理等任务，并依据最终状态评分。
entries.limits_en: Uses simulated workplace tools rather than real email accounts or desktop apps. The 2026 task corrections and evaluator differ from the original release; report the ground-truth and scoring versions.
entries.limits_zh: 使用模拟办公工具，并非真实邮箱账户或桌面应用。2026 年的任务修订和评分器与原始版本不同，应报告标准答案及评分版本。
entries.enables_en: Measure task completion and unintended state changes in controlled office workflows.
entries.enables_zh: 在受控办公流程中衡量任务完成情况和非预期状态变更。
entries.runtime: Python; local sandbox databases and tools
entries.platform_note: Tool/API simulation rather than an operating-system-specific GUI environment.

evidence.supports: Documents five sandbox databases, 26 tools, outcome evaluation, 2026 revisions and versioned ground truth.
Original paper defines workplace tasks and outcome-centric evaluation.
Tool domains cover email, calendar, analytics, CRM and project management.

entries.name: BrowserART
entries.description_en: A browser-agent safety evaluation toolkit with synthetic websites, behavior datasets and trajectory classifiers for studying whether agents follow harmful requests.
entries.description_zh: 浏览器 Agent 安全评估工具包，提供合成网站、行为数据和轨迹分类器，用于研究 Agent 是否执行有害请求。
entries.limits_en: A specialized safety benchmark rather than a general task-success ranking. It mixes synthetic and live-site tasks; the code is MIT-licensed while the behavior dataset lists CC BY-NC 4.0.
entries.limits_zh: 属于专门的安全基准，不是通用任务成功率排行榜。任务同时涉及合成和在线网站；代码采用 MIT，行为数据集标注 CC BY-NC 4.0。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate browser-agent refusal behavior in a controlled research setup and inspect recorded trajectories.
entries.enables_zh: 在受控研究配置中评估浏览器 Agent 的拒绝行为，并检查操作轨迹。

evidence.supports: Defines the safety evaluation toolkit, behavior classifiers, synthetic website source and MIT code license.
Documents local website hosting and BrowserGym/OpenDevin evaluation setup.
Official behavior dataset card specifies CC BY-NC 4.0.

entries.name: Spider2-V
entries.description_en: An executable desktop benchmark for data-science and engineering workflows that combine code, GUI actions and enterprise tools such as dbt, Airbyte and BigQuery.
entries.description_zh: 面向数据科学与工程流程的可执行桌面基准，结合代码、GUI 操作以及 dbt、Airbyte、BigQuery 等企业工具。
entries.limits_en: Requires the prepared Ubuntu VM and setup dependencies. Some tasks need real cloud accounts and credentials; account/non-account and abstract/verbose instruction subsets are different evaluation settings.
entries.limits_zh: 需要预设 Ubuntu 虚拟机和配套依赖。部分任务需要真实云账户及凭证；有账户／无账户、简要／详细指令属于不同评测设置。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate whether agents can carry a data workflow across graphical interfaces, code and task-specific state checks.
entries.enables_zh: 通过图形界面、代码和任务专用状态检查，评估 Agent 完成数据工作流程的能力。
entries.platform_note: The executable guest environment is Ubuntu; host support does not imply macOS or Windows task coverage.

evidence.supports: Project page describes 494 tasks, professional data tools and the executable Ubuntu desktop.
Documents VM installation, account requirements and the separate instruction/account subsets.

entries.name: NetHack Learning Environment
entries.description_en: A Gymnasium interface to NetHack with procedurally generated dungeons, inventory management and long sequences of consequential actions.
entries.description_zh: 为 NetHack 提供 Gymnasium 接口，包含程序化生成的地牢、物品管理和需要连续决策的任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires Python 3.10+, CMake 3.28+ and native build dependencies. The current repository uses NetHack 3.6.7 and the NetHack General Public License; older NLE releases differ.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Python 3.10+、CMake 3.28+ 和原生构建依赖。当前仓库基于 NetHack 3.6.7，采用 NetHack General Public License；旧版 NLE 的依赖与行为可能不同。
entries.enables_en: Train agents on exploration, survival and inventory decisions, or compare policies on defined NetHack tasks.
entries.enables_zh: 训练探索、生存和物品决策能力，或在明确的 NetHack 任务上比较策略。
entries.runtime: Python/Gymnasium with a native NetHack backend; pip install nle; local human-play and random-agent scripts.

evidence.supports: Documents the current NetHack version, Gymnasium interface, installation, macOS/Ubuntu instructions and runnable scripts.
The repository publishes the NetHack General Public License.
Original NLE paper describes the game-based RL environment and evaluation tasks.

entries.name: MineDojo
entries.description_en: A Minecraft research suite that combines survival, resource-gathering, creative and playthrough tasks with a separate knowledge collection.
entries.description_zh: 基于 Minecraft 的研究套件，提供生存、资源收集、创作和通关任务，并配有独立的知识资料库。
entries.limits_en: Requires Python 3.9+, JDK 8 and a Minecraft backend; headless runs need the documented display setup. Code is MIT, while the Wiki database is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 and other databases have separate terms.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Python 3.9+、JDK 8 和 Minecraft 后端；无显示器运行需按文档配置。代码采用 MIT；Wiki 数据库采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0，其他数据库另有许可。
entries.enables_en: Build agents that follow varied Minecraft goals and study how external knowledge supports exploration and crafting.
entries.enables_zh: 构建遵循不同 Minecraft 目标的 Agent，研究外部知识对探索和制作的帮助。
entries.runtime: Python Gym-style API; pip install minedojo; prerequisites and a Docker path are documented.

evidence.supports: Documents the task families, Python/JDK requirements, tested Ubuntu/macOS setups, API examples and component-specific licenses.
Author installation instructions cover prerequisites and headless/Docker operation.
Original paper describes the Minecraft simulation suite, knowledge bases and agent-learning setting.

entries.name: MineRL
entries.description_en: A Python interface to Minecraft research tasks, with versioned environments and a separate collection of human demonstrations.
entries.description_zh: 为 Minecraft 研究任务提供 Python 接口，包含分版本维护的环境，以及独立的人类操作示范数据。
entries.limits_en: JDK 8 is required; Windows needs bash/WSL and macOS may need extra setup. v1.0 differs from the original dataset environments. Licensing metadata conflicts: root LICENSE says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but setup.py says MIT; do not assume a single permissive license.
entries.limits_zh: 必须使用 JDK 8；Windows 需要 bash/WSL，macOS 可能需额外配置。v1.0 与原始数据对应的环境不同。许可信息存在冲突：根 LICENSE 写为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，而 setup.py 标注 MIT，不能直接视为统一的宽松许可。
entries.enables_en: Train or evaluate Minecraft control policies while explicitly matching environment and demonstration-data versions.
entries.enables_zh: 在明确匹配环境与示范数据版本的前提下，训练或评估 Minecraft 控制策略。
entries.runtime: Python/Gym and Java JDK 8; install from the author repository; v0 data mirrors were replaced by a linked Zenodo record.

evidence.supports: Documents v1.0/v0.4/v0.3 differences, JDK 8, runnable tasks and the replacement data record.
Author setup page documents Windows bash/WSL, macOS and Debian/Ubuntu requirements.
Root license text is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Package metadata separately declares MIT, so this review does not resolve the conflict.
Original paper concerns MineRL human demonstrations paired with simulator tasks.

entries.platform_note: Windows is documented with bash/WSL requirements; this is not a claim of a dependency-free native Windows build.

entries.name: BALROG
entries.description_en: An evaluation harness for language and vision-language agents across existing interactive games, including text adventures and NetHack-based tasks.
entries.description_zh: 在现有交互游戏上评估语言与视觉语言 Agent 的框架，覆盖文字冒险和基于 NetHack 的任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires the bundled environments and post-install setup, plus a local model server or paid API access where chosen. The harness is MIT; underlying games keep their own licenses. It is not a newly AI-built game.
entries.limits_zh: 需要安装所依赖的环境并完成后置配置，还需自备本地模型服务或所选付费 API。评测框架采用 MIT，各底层游戏保留自身许可；它并非新生成的 AI 游戏作品。
entries.enables_en: Run a common evaluation workflow across games and compare long-horizon reasoning under explicit agent and observation settings.
entries.enables_zh: 通过统一流程运行多款游戏评测，并在明确 Agent 与观察设置的前提下比较长期推理能力。
entries.runtime: Python 3.10; editable install and balrog-post-install; author Dockerfile uses Ubuntu and README gives macOS notes.

evidence.supports: Documents the evaluation harness, installation, API/local model options, macOS notes and MIT license.
Published Docker configuration uses Ubuntu 22.04 and Python 3.10.
Paper defines the multi-environment agent reasoning evaluation setting.

entries.name: OpenSpiel
entries.description_en: A framework of game environments and algorithms for single-agent and multi-agent learning, search and planning with different information structures.
entries.description_zh: 集成多种游戏环境与算法的研究框架，支持不同信息条件下的单 Agent、多 Agent 学习、搜索与规划。
entries.limits_en: This is a research framework rather than a hosted game. Optional games and algorithms add dependencies. Windows wheels and build instructions are documented, but the Windows page labels support experimental. Repository code is Apache 2.0.
entries.limits_zh: 这是研究框架，并非在线游戏服务；可选游戏与算法会增加依赖。文档提供 Windows wheel 和构建说明，同时将 Windows 支持标为实验性。仓库代码采用 Apache 2.0。
entries.enables_en: Compare decision-making algorithms on games with cooperation, competition, simultaneous actions or hidden information.
entries.enables_zh: 在合作、竞争、同时行动或隐藏信息等游戏条件下比较决策算法。
entries.runtime: C++ core with Python bindings; pip installation or source/Docker builds; separate Windows instructions.

evidence.supports: Defines supported game types, learning/planning use and C++/Python interfaces.
Documents Linux/macOS pip and source installation.
Documents Windows wheels and builds and explicitly labels Windows support experimental.
Repository license is Apache 2.0.
Original OpenSpiel framework paper.

entries.name: Procgen Benchmark
entries.description_en: A suite of sixteen procedurally generated visual games designed to separate learning on familiar levels from generalization to unseen levels.
entries.description_zh: 由十六款程序化生成的视觉游戏组成的基准，用于区分熟悉关卡上的学习表现和未见关卡上的泛化表现。
entries.limits_en: The maintenance-mode README lists older Python 3.7–3.10 builds, 64-bit platforms and an AVX-capable CPU. Compatibility with other setups is unverified here. Code is MIT; bundled assets include distinct attribution licenses.
entries.limits_zh: 项目处于维护模式，README 列出较旧的 Python 3.7–3.10 构建、64 位平台和 AVX CPU 要求；本次未验证其他配置的兼容性。代码采用 MIT，内置素材包含独立的署名许可。
entries.enables_en: Train on selected level seeds and evaluate on new seeds to study generalization in arcade-style control.
entries.enables_zh: 在指定关卡种子上训练，并在新种子上评估街机操作策略的泛化能力。
entries.runtime: Python Gym/gym3 with a C++/Qt backend; pip install procgen; local interactive player and Docker examples.

evidence.supports: Documents sixteen games, level seeds, interfaces, installation, platforms, CPU constraints and maintenance status.
Repository code is MIT licensed.
Lists asset-specific CC0, CC BY and OGA BY licenses.
Paper defines procedural generation as a means to evaluate RL generalization.

entries.name: Arcade Learning Environment
entries.description_en: A Stella-based Atari 2600 interface that exposes observations, actions, game scores and episode endings to learning agents.
entries.description_zh: 基于 Stella 模拟器的 Atari 2600 接口，为学习型 Agent 提供观察、动作、游戏得分和回合终止信号。
entries.limits_en: Current packages include ROMs, unlike older AutoROM-based instructions. Results depend on environment settings and versions. ALE code is GPL 2.0; this review does not establish separate rights for game ROM redistribution.
entries.limits_zh: 当前安装包已包含 ROM，与旧版 AutoROM 安装流程不同。结果依赖环境设置和版本。ALE 代码采用 GPL 2.0；本次审查未确认游戏 ROM 的独立再分发权利。
entries.enables_en: Train and compare agents through standard Atari interfaces while recording the game and evaluation settings.
entries.enables_zh: 通过标准 Atari 接口训练和比较 Agent，并记录游戏及评测配置。
entries.runtime: C++/Python/Gymnasium interfaces; pip install ale-py; documented WebAssembly/browser support.

evidence.supports: Documents Atari interaction, score signals, native platforms, packaged ROMs and WebAssembly support.
Documents the move to packaged ROMs and changes to registration/setup.
Published ALE code license is GNU GPL version 2.
Original paper introduces ALE as an evaluation platform for general agents.

entries.platform_note: The web tag follows explicit WebAssembly support; it does not assert that every Python benchmark configuration runs in a browser.

entries.name: ScienceWorld
entries.description_en: A text-based simulated world where agents manipulate objects and perform elementary science tasks such as heating, classification and electrical experiments.
entries.description_zh: 以文字交互的模拟世界，Agent 可操作物体，完成加热、分类和电学实验等基础科学任务。
entries.limits_en: Requires Python 3.8+ and Java 1.8+. It is a symbolic science simulation, not physical laboratory validation. Version 1.3 changes ordering and can alter trajectories relative to 1.2; pin versions for comparisons. Code is Apache 2.0.
entries.limits_zh: 需要 Python 3.8+ 与 Java 1.8+。它是符号化科学模拟，不能代替真实实验验证。1.3 版改变对象排序，可能产生不同于 1.2 的轨迹；比较实验应固定版本。代码采用 Apache 2.0。
entries.enables_en: Evaluate action sequences that apply scientific knowledge, with controlled task variations and optional environment simplifications.
entries.enables_zh: 在可控任务变体和可选环境简化条件下，评估 Agent 运用科学知识完成动作序列的能力。
entries.runtime: Scala/Java simulator with a Python API; pip install scienceworld; local text console and optional browser console.

evidence.supports: Documents science tasks, Python/Java requirements, local consoles and the version 1.3 reproducibility change.
Repository code is Apache 2.0 licensed.
Paper describes interactive science tasks and agent evaluation.

entries.platform_note: No OS tag is inferred from the Python/Java runtime. The game category denotes an interactive research world, not a commercial game.

entries.name: VirtualHome
entries.description_en: A household activity simulator that executes action programs, with a Unity visual environment and a separate evolving scene-graph backend.
entries.description_zh: 可执行家庭活动动作程序的模拟器，提供 Unity 视觉环境和独立的动态场景图后端。
entries.limits_en: The rendered mode needs a separate Unity executable; headless operation needs additional setup. Graph and Unity backends do not support identical actions. API code is MIT; downloaded simulator/assets were not license-audited here.
entries.limits_zh: 渲染模式需要另行下载 Unity 可执行文件，无显示器运行需额外配置。场景图和 Unity 后端支持的动作并不完全相同。API 代码采用 MIT；本次未审计下载版模拟器及素材的许可。
entries.enables_en: Generate household activity trajectories and build embodied-agent training tasks with object interactions and scene state.
entries.enables_zh: 生成家庭活动轨迹，并利用物体交互与场景状态构建具身 Agent 训练任务。
entries.runtime: Python API via pip install virtualhome; author-provided Unity downloads for Linux, macOS and Windows.

evidence.supports: Documents household action programs, embodied training, two backends, platform-specific executables and headless requirements.
API repository publishes the MIT license.
Original paper describes program-driven household activity simulation.
A household-activity virtual environment with documented Linux, macOS and Windows executables.

entries.name: MiniGrid
entries.description_en: A configurable collection of small grid worlds for navigation, object manipulation and instruction following, including the BabyAI environments.
entries.description_zh: 可配置的小型网格世界集合，覆盖导航、物体操作和指令执行，并包含 BabyAI 环境。
entries.limits_en: Current README requires Python 3.11+ and does not officially support Windows. Licensing is inconsistent in the reviewed branch: pyproject.toml says MIT, while LICENSE contains incomplete Apache 2.0 text. A definitive license was not established.
entries.limits_zh: 当前 README 要求 Python 3.11+，并未正式支持 Windows。所审查分支的许可信息不一致：pyproject.toml 标注 MIT，但 LICENSE 含不完整的 Apache 2.0 文本；本次未确定最终适用许可。
entries.enables_en: Create controlled curricula and evaluate navigation, memory and language-conditioned action composition.
entries.enables_zh: 构建可控课程，评估导航、记忆和语言条件下的动作组合。
entries.runtime: Python/Gymnasium; pip install minigrid; customizable mission strings, map sizes and task configurations.

evidence.supports: Documents MiniGrid/BabyAI tasks, Gymnasium, installation and explicitly supported Linux/macOS platforms.
Package metadata declares MIT.
Reviewed root file instead contains incomplete Apache 2.0 text, so the license conflict is preserved.
Author paper describes MiniGrid and MiniWorld design, APIs and goal-oriented tasks.

entries.name: Jericho
entries.description_en: A Python interface connecting agents to interactive-fiction games, with access to game state and controls for reproducible play.
entries.description_zh: 将 Agent 连接到交互式文字冒险游戏的 Python 接口，提供游戏状态访问及可复现运行所需的控制。
entries.limits_en: Current requirements include Linux, Python 3.12+, spaCy and build tools; game files are separate. Version 4 changes default seeding, so record seeds and versions. Interface code is GPL 2.0; individual games retain separate rights.
entries.limits_zh: 当前依赖包括 Linux、Python 3.12+、spaCy 和构建工具，游戏文件需单独准备。第 4 版改变默认种子行为，应记录种子与版本。接口代码采用 GPL 2.0，各游戏保留独立权利。
entries.enables_en: Study language-based exploration and planning across existing text adventures with explicit reproducibility settings.
entries.enables_zh: 在现有文字冒险中研究基于语言的探索和规划，并明确记录复现设置。
entries.runtime: Python interface to Frotz; pip install jericho plus the documented spaCy model; load a supported game file.

evidence.supports: Documents the interactive-fiction interface, current Linux/Python requirements and version 4 seed changes.
Repository license is GNU GPL version 2.
Original paper introduces Jericho and its text-game research setting.

entries.limits_en: The game is a coding showcase without a published agent evaluator. The hosted HTML returned 200; gameplay was not tested. Repository code is MIT licensed.
